display_title: Second Male Lead, It's a Contract Marriage, You Say?
description:
I found myself possessed by the body of “Villainous Supporting Character No. 1,” who gets executed just for making a snide remark to the female lead, who seemed close to the male lead.

 *“I’m just Villainous Supporting Character No. 1 anyway. If I don’t do it, someone else will.”*

With that in mind, I tried my best not to get involved with any of the characters in the original story, and the story ended without incident. But then, the secondary male lead from the original story came looking for me. 

*“By any chance, are you interested in a contract marriage?”*

He asked, waving a contract in front of me with the sweetest expression on his face.

(Source: Naver, translated)
